stories.headline: Bedard gets back to 'what I live for' with quick return to Blackhawks
stories.nhlSummary: CHICAGO -- Connor Bedard stood in the locker room sporting a backward baseball cap on his head and a sizeable vertical scar on his shoulder, the latter the souvenir of his surgery in July.

takeaways.nhl:8484144: Bedard returned from July shoulder surgery, playing 21:06 as top-line center with Kane and Kantserov, recording an assist on power play.

stories.nhlSummary: ARLINGTON, Va. -- Rob Hutson called his son Cole Hutson after a recent game only to find the Washington Capitals rookie defenseman was already on the phone with one of his brothers.

stories.headline: Preds Start Homestand With Loss to Golden Knights
stories.nhlSummary:
The Nashville Predators began a three-game homestand with a 5-2 loss to the Vegas Golden Knights on Tuesday night at Bridgestone Arena. The result brings an end to Nashville’s four-game point streak in a game against the defending Western Conference champions.

stories.headline: Peterson has fight, 4 hits in NHL debut
stories.nhlSummary: Forward Dylan Peterson made his NHL regular-season debut for the St. Louis Blues in Tuesday's 7-2 win against the Ottawa Senators at Canadian Tire Center. He is the first Blues rookie forward to make his NHL debut since Otto Stenberg did so against the Winnipeg Jets on Dec. 17, 2025.

takeaways.nhl:8482121: Dylan Peterson made his NHL debut on the Blues' fourth line, playing 8:57 with four hits and a fighting major.
